voiceNote: English prose is synthesized; it is explanation, not recitation. Every Arabic term spoken here is drawn from content/qaidah/lexicon.json and is a term, never a passage.

segments.en: These are the first seven letters. Listen for where each one is made in the mouth.
The first letter is alif. It is made deep in the throat.
Baa is made with the two lips, gently together.
